description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionServices class, which provides various static methods for managing subscription lifecycle events such as extending subscriptions, processing subscriptions based on products or orders, handling subscription expiry, and related services within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SubscriptionServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling subscription-related operations such as extending, creating, updating, and expiring subscriptions within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: processExtendSubscription
methods.description: Extends or creates a subscription record for a party based on provided parameters, adjusting dates according to usage time and units.

methods.name: processExtendSubscriptionByProduct
methods.description: Automatically extends subscriptions related to a specified product, based on quantity and product subscription resources.

methods.name: processExtendSubscriptionByOrder
methods.description: Extends subscriptions associated with a specific order by iterating over order items and invoking extension logic.

methods.name: runServiceOnSubscriptionExpiry
methods.description: Checks for expired subscriptions and triggers associated expiry services, updating subscription statuses accordingly.

methods.name: runSubscriptionExpired
methods.description: Placeholder service called when a subscription has expired, currently returning a success message if subscriptionId is provided.
